title: Prism intro
summary: Lighter photo library stub. Mark interested or installed when you try it.

start.body: Prism is the lighter photo path when Immich feels like too many containers. This walkthrough is a short introduction — enough to decide.

fit.body: You want a browsable library on the lab box and phone upload later. You do not need face clustering on day one.

choices.label: I already run it — mark installed

interested.body: Noted. Follow the Prism docs for your OS when you have an evening. Prefer LAN-only until you know the auth story.

installed.body: Good. Keep a second copy of the library off the box — same rule as any photo pile.

skip.body: Fine. Immich or plain folder backup still cover most houses.
